#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a tutorial pack of radiation MC + LQ under radiation/, by syllabus subtopic."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import shutil
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import pymupdf as fitz

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROCESSED = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/processed")
MC_JSON = PROCESSED / "MC" / "mc_questions.json"
LQ_JSON = PROCESSED / "LQ" / "lq_questions.json"
WORKSPACE_MC = ROOT / "output"

# Syllabus folders (order used in README).
SUBTOPICS: list[str] = [
    "25.1 Ionizing radiation",
    "25.2A Atomic model",
    "25.2B Radioactive decay",
    "25.2C Sources of nuclear radiation",
    "25.3A Ionising power",
    "25.3B Detection of nuclear radiation",
    "25.3C Range in air and penetrating power",
    "25.3D Deflection in electric and magnetic fields",
    "25.4 Rates of radioactive decay half-life and activity",
    "25.5A Archaeological use",
    "25.5B Radiation safety and dose",
    "27.1A Common units on the atomic scale",
    "27.1B Mass-energy relation",
    "27.1C Nuclear fission",
    "27.1D Nuclear fusion",
    "27.1E Nuclear power debate",
]

# (subtopic, keywords, weight) - higher weight / more hits wins.
RULES: list[tuple[str, list[str], int]] = []


def add(subtopic: str, keywords: list[str], weight: int) -> None:
    RULES.append((subtopic, [k.lower() for k in keywords], weight))


# Most specific first in practice via weights.
add("25.5A Archaeological use", [
    "archaeolog", "carbon-14", "carbon 14", "c-14", "dating", "radiocarbon",
    "age of the wood", "age of the object", "mummy",
], 48)
add("25.3D Deflection in electric and magnetic fields", [
    "deflect", "magnetic field pointing", "electric field", "into the paper",
    "uniform magnetic", "cloud chamber track", "path of the particle",
    "positively charged", "negatively charged particle",
], 46)
add("25.3C Range in air and penetrating power", [
    "penetrat", "absorber", "aluminium", "aluminum", "lead sheet", "cardboard",
    "paper", "range in air", "stopped by", "mm thick", "shielding material",
    "most penetrating", "least penetrating",
], 44)
add("25.3A Ionising power", [
    "ionising power", "ionizing power", "ionisation power", "ionization power",
    "most ionising", "least ionising", "most ionizing", "least ionizing",
    "ionise air", "ionize air", "strongly ionising", "strongly ionizing",
], 44)
add("25.3B Detection of nuclear radiation", [
    "gm counter", "geiger", "g-m", "g.m.", "cloud chamber", "scintillation",
    "count rate", "background count", "gm tube", "detector",
], 40)
add("25.5B Radiation safety and dose", [
    "equivalent dose", "absorbed dose", "sievert", "gray", "health hazard",
    "radiation hazard", "radiotherapy", "radiation safety", "protective",
    "time distance shielding", "biological effect", "damage to cells",
    "cancer", "mutation", "safe handling", "radiation dose",
], 42)
add("27.1D Nuclear fusion", [
    "fusion", "deuterium", "tritium", "star", "sun", "thermonuclear",
    "join together", "combine to form",
], 40)
add("27.1C Nuclear fission", [
    "fission", "chain reaction", "uranium-235", "u-235", "235u", "neutron bombards",
    "splits into", "nuclear reactor fuel", "control rod", "moderator",
], 40)
add("27.1E Nuclear power debate", [
    "nuclear power", "nuclear plant", "nuclear waste", "radioactive waste",
    "advantage of nuclear", "disadvantage of nuclear", "chernobyl", "fukushima",
    "public debate", "nuclear energy debate",
], 38)
add("27.1B Mass-energy relation", [
    "mass defect", "binding energy", "e = mc", "e=mc", "mass-energy",
    "energy released", "mass converted", "rest mass", "1 u =", "931",
], 36)
add("27.1A Common units on the atomic scale", [
    "atomic mass unit", "unified atomic", "electron-volt", "electron volt",
    "mev", "kev", "unit u", "in terms of u",
], 34)
add("25.4 Rates of radioactive decay half-life and activity", [
    "half-life", "half life", "halflife", "activity", "decay constant",
    "becquerel", "bq", "mbq", "kbq", "undecayed", "number of nuclei",
    "rate of decay", "radioactive decay rate", "n = n0", "a = a0",
], 38)
add("25.2B Radioactive decay", [
    "alpha decay", "beta decay", "a-decay", "b-decay", "α", "β",
    "decay series", "undergoes", "emits an alpha", "emits a beta",
    "nuclide", "isotope", "atomic number", "mass number",
    "daughter", "parent nucleus", "a and b decay", "α and β",
], 32)
add("25.2C Sources of nuclear radiation", [
    "radioactive source", "radioisotope", "tracer", "background radiation",
    "cosmic", "radon", "natural source", "artificial source",
    "smoke detector", "locate the crack", "underground water pipe",
], 30)
add("25.2A Atomic model", [
    "rutherford", "thomson", "thompson", "plum pudding", "bohr",
    "atomic model", "gold foil", "nucleus of an atom", "orbiting electron",
    "planetary model", "discovery of nucleus",
], 34)
add("25.1 Ionizing radiation", [
    "ionizing radiation", "ionising radiation", "ionizing", "ionising",
    "ionize", "ionise", "produce ions", "knock electrons",
], 28)

# Must look radiation-related overall (gate).
GATE = [
    "radioactiv", "nuclear", "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "α", "β", "γ",
    "half-life", "half life", "geiger", "gm counter", "nuclide", "isotope",
    "fission", "fusion", "binding energy", "mass defect", "becquerel",
    "sievert", "radiation", "decay", "uranium", "plutonium", "radium",
    "polonium", "carbon-14", "deuterium", "tritium", "cloud chamber",
    "ionising", "ionizing", "atomic mass unit", "rutherford", "thomson",
]


def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.lower()
    text = text.replace("α", "alpha").replace("β", "beta").replace("γ", "gamma")
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s./=+*-]+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return text


def keyword_hit(blob: str, keyword: str) -> bool:
    if " " in keyword or "." in keyword or "-" in keyword or "/" in keyword or "=" in keyword:
        return keyword in blob
    return re.search(rf"(?<![a-z0-9]){re.escape(keyword)}(?![a-z0-9])", blob) is not None


def blob_of(record: dict) -> str:
    parts = [record.get("Question statement") or ""]
    opts = record.get("Option") or {}
    if isinstance(opts, dict):
        parts.extend(str(v) for v in opts.values())
    return normalize(" ".join(parts))


def passes_gate(blob: str) -> bool:
    return any(keyword_hit(blob, g) or g in blob for g in GATE)


def classify(record: dict) -> tuple[str, int] | None:
    blob = blob_of(record)
    if not passes_gate(blob):
        return None
    # Skip photoelectric / pure X-ray imaging unless nuclear keywords dominate.
    if ("photoelectric" in blob or "work function" in blob) and "nuclear" not in blob and "radioactiv" not in blob:
        return None
    scored: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
    for subtopic, keywords, weight in RULES:
        hits = sum(1 for kw in keywords if keyword_hit(blob, kw))
        if hits == 0:
            continue
        scored.append((subtopic, weight + hits * 4))
    if not scored:
        # Gate passed but no fine match - dump to ionizing / decay catch-alls.
        if any(k in blob for k in ("fission", "fusion", "binding", "mass defect")):
            return ("27.1B Mass-energy relation", 1)
        if any(k in blob for k in ("half", "activit", "decay")):
            return ("25.4 Rates of radioactive decay half-life and activity", 1)
        return ("25.1 Ionizing radiation", 1)
    scored.sort(key=lambda t: t[1], reverse=True)
    return scored[0]


def mc_png(record: dict) -> Path:
    year, qn = record["Year"], record["Question"]
    for base in (PROCESSED / "MC", WORKSPACE_MC):
        path = base / str(year) / f"q{qn}.png"
        if path.exists():
            return path
    return PROCESSED / "MC" / str(year) / f"q{qn}.png"


def lq_png(record: dict) -> Path:
    year, qn = record["Year"], record["Question"]
    return PROCESSED / "LQ" / str(year) / f"q{qn}.png"


def dest_name(record: dict) -> str:
    return f"{record['Year']}_q{record['Question']}.png"


def sort_key(record: dict):
    year = record["Year"]
    year_key = (0, int(year)) if str(year).isdigit() else (1, str(year))
    return (*year_key, int(record["Question"]))


def write_pdf(paths: list[Path], dest: Path) -> None:
    if not paths:
        if dest.exists():
            dest.unlink()
        return
    doc = fitz.open()
    try:
        for path in paths:
            image = fitz.open(path)
            try:
                rect = image[0].rect
                page = doc.new_page(width=rect.width, height=rect.height)
                page.insert_image(page.rect, filename=str(path))
            finally:
                image.close()
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        doc.save(dest, garbage=4, deflate=True)
    finally:
        doc.close()


def main() -> None:
    # Wipe previous pack contents except this script.
    for child in list(OUT.iterdir()):
        if child.name == "build_radiation_pack.py":
            continue
        if child.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(child)
        else:
            child.unlink()

    mc_records = json.loads(MC_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    lq_records = json.loads(LQ_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    buckets: dict[str, dict[str, list[dict]]] = {
        s: {"mc": [], "lq": []} for s in SUBTOPICS
    }
    classification: list[dict] = []

    for kind, records, png_fn in (
        ("mc", mc_records, mc_png),
        ("lq", lq_records, lq_png),
    ):
        for record in records:
            result = classify(record)
            if result is None:
                continue
            subtopic, score = result
            src = png_fn(record)
            if not src.exists():
                print(f"missing {kind} png: {src}")
                continue
            buckets[subtopic][kind].append(record)
            classification.append(
                {
                    "Type": kind.upper(),
                    "Year": record["Year"],
                    "Question": record["Question"],
                    "Subtopic": subtopic,
                    "score": score,
                    "PNG": str(src),
                }
            )

    summary: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    all_mc: list[Path] = []
    all_lq: list[Path] = []
    seen_mc: set[str] = set()
    seen_lq: set[str] = set()

    for subtopic in SUBTOPICS:
        folder = OUT / subtopic
        mc_dir = folder / "mc"
        lq_dir = folder / "lq"
        mc_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        lq_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        mc_paths: list[Path] = []
        for record in sorted(buckets[subtopic]["mc"], key=sort_key):
            src = mc_png(record)
            dest = mc_dir / dest_name(record)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a tutorial pack of radiation MC + LQ under radiation/, by syllabus subtopic."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import pymupdf as fitz

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROCESSED = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Materials/Phy/dse/processed")
MC_JSON = PROCESSED / "MC" / "mc_questions.json"
LQ_JSON = PROCESSED / "LQ" / "lq_questions.json"
WORKSPACE_MC = ROOT / "output"

SUBTOPICS: list[str] = [
    "25.1 Ionizing radiation",

    "27.1A Common units on the atomic scale",
    "27.1B Mass-energy relation",
    "27.1C Nuclear fission",
    "27.1D Nuclear fusion",
    "27.1E Nuclear power debate",
]

RULES: list[tuple[str, list[str], int]] = []


def add(subtopic: str, keywords: list[str], weight: int) -> None:
    RULES.append((subtopic, [k.lower() for k in keywords], weight))


add("25.5A Archaeological use", [

], 48)
add("25.3C Range in air and penetrating power", [

    "lead sheet", "cardboard", "range in air", "stopped by",
    "most penetrating", "least penetrating", "mm thick aluminum",
    "mm thick aluminium", "mm thick lead", "sheet of paper",
], 46)
add("25.3A Ionising power", [
    "ionising power", "ionizing power", "ionisation power", "ionization power",
    "most ionising", "least ionising", "most ionizing", "least ionizing",
    "strongly ionising", "strongly ionizing", "ionising ability", "ionizing ability",
], 46)
add("25.3B Detection of nuclear radiation", [
    "gm counter", "geiger", "g-m tube", "gm tube", "geiger-muller",

], 44)

], 44)
add("27.1D Nuclear fusion", [

], 46)
add("27.1C Nuclear fission", [
    "nuclear fission", "fission", "chain reaction", "uranium-235",
    "u-235", "235u", "control rod", "moderator", "splits into",
], 44)
add("27.1E Nuclear power debate", [
    "nuclear power plant", "nuclear power station", "nuclear waste",
    "radioactive waste", "advantage of nuclear", "disadvantage of nuclear",

], 42)
add("27.1B Mass-energy relation", [
    "mass defect", "binding energy", "e = mc", "e=mc", "mass-energy",
    "energy released", "mass converted", "931",
], 40)
add("27.1A Common units on the atomic scale", [
    "atomic mass unit", "unified atomic mass", "electron-volt",

], 38)
add("25.4 Rates of radioactive decay half-life and activity", [
    "half-life", "half life", "halflife", "activity", "decay constant",
    "becquerel", " mbq", " kbq", "undecayed", "rate of decay",

], 42)
add("25.2B Radioactive decay", [
    "alpha decay", "beta decay", "a-decay", "b-decay", "decay series",
    "emits an alpha", "emits a beta", "undergoes a", "undergoes b",
    "daughter", "parent nucleus", "a and b decay", "alpha and beta",
    "atomic number and mass number", "nuclide x",
], 36)
add("25.2C Sources of nuclear radiation", [
    "radioactive source", "radioisotope", "tracer", "background radiation",
    "cosmic ray", "radon", "natural source", "artificial source",
    "smoke detector", "locate the crack", "underground water pipe",
    "sources of ionizing", "sources of ionising",
], 36)
add("25.2A Atomic model", [
    "rutherford", "thomson model", "thompson model", "plum pudding",
    "bohr model", "atomic model", "gold foil", "discovery of the nucleus",
    "planetary model", "nucleus of an atom",
], 40)
add("25.1 Ionizing radiation", [
    "ionizing radiation", "ionising radiation", "ionizing radiations",
    "ionising radiations", "produce ions", "knock electrons off",
], 32)

# Strict nuclear / radioactivity gate (avoid heat "fusion", IR "radiation").
GATE = [
    "radioactiv", "nuclear radiation", "nuclear reaction", "nuclear fission",
    "nuclear fusion", "thermonuclear", "half-life", "half life", "geiger",
    "gm counter", "gm tube", "nuclide", "isotope", "becquerel", "sievert",
    "alpha particle", "beta particle", "gamma ray", "gamma radiation",
    "a-particle", "b-particle", "α", "β-particle", "fission",
    "deuterium", "tritium", "uranium", "plutonium", "radium", "polonium",
    "carbon-14", "binding energy", "mass defect", "cloud chamber",
    "ionizing radiation", "ionising radiation", "rutherford", "plum pudding",
    "decay constant", "radioisotope", "activity of", "count rate",
]

# Manual fixes when OCR / keyword bleed is wrong.
MC_OVERRIDES: dict[tuple[int | str, int], str] = {
    (2014, 31): "25.2B Radioactive decay",
    (2015, 31): "27.1C Nuclear fission",  # spontaneous nuclear reactions incl fission/fusion examples
    (2015, 32): "25.5B Radiation safety and dose",  # film badge dosage
    (2021, 8): "25.2B Radioactive decay",
    (2021, 33): "25.2C Sources of nuclear radiation",
    (2024, 33): "25.2C Sources of nuclear radiation",
    (2026, 32): "25.5B Radiation safety and dose",
}
LQ_OVERRIDES: dict[tuple[int | str, int], str] = {
    (2012, 10): None,  # type: ignore[dict-item]  # EM induction, not radiation
    (2013, 9): "25.5A Archaeological use",
    (2014, 10): "25.2C Sources of nuclear radiation",  # RTG plutonium source
    (2015, 1): None,  # diver / gas laws
    (2015, 10): "27.1D Nuclear fusion",
    (2016, 9): "25.2B Radioactive decay",
    (2017, 2): None,  # CRT speed of light / not radiation
    (2018, 9): None,
    (2018, 10): "25.3B Detection of nuclear radiation",  # spark counter
    (2022, 10): "27.1D Nuclear fusion",
}


def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.lower()
    text = text.replace("α", "alpha").replace("β", "beta").replace("γ", "gamma")
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s./=+*-]+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    # Kill latent-heat "fusion" so it cannot score as nuclear fusion.
    text = text.replace("latent heat of fusion", "latent heat of melting")
    text = text.replace("specific latent heat of fusion", "specific latent heat of melting")
    text = text.replace("heat of fusion", "heat of melting")
    text = text.replace("undergoes the fusion process", "undergoes the melting process")
    return text


def keyword_hit(blob: str, keyword: str) -> bool:
    if len(keyword) <= 2:
        return keyword in blob
    if " " in keyword or "." in keyword or "-" in keyword or "/" in keyword or "=" in keyword:
        return keyword in blob
    return re.search(rf"(?<![a-z0-9]){re.escape(keyword)}(?![a-z0-9])", blob) is not None


def blob_of(record: dict) -> str:
    parts = [record.get("Question statement") or ""]
    opts = record.get("Option") or {}
    if isinstance(opts, dict):
        parts.extend(str(v) for v in opts.values())
    return normalize(" ".join(parts))


def passes_gate(blob: str, record: dict) -> bool:
    if record.get("Chapter") == "Radiation":
        # Still drop photoelectric / pure IR / heat mislabels.
        if "photoelectric" in blob or "work function" in blob:
            return False
        if "infra-red" in blob or "infrared" in blob:
            if not any(k in blob for k in ("radioactiv", "nuclear", "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "half")):
                return False
        return True
    return any(keyword_hit(blob, g) or g in blob for g in GATE)


def classify(record: dict, kind: str) -> tuple[str, int] | None:
    key = (record["Year"], record["Question"])
    overrides = MC_OVERRIDES if kind == "mc" else LQ_OVERRIDES
    if key in overrides:
        forced = overrides[key]
        if forced is None:
            return None
        return forced, 999

    blob = blob_of(record)
    if not passes_gate(blob, record):
        return None
    if ("photoelectric" in blob or "work function" in blob) and "nuclear" not in blob:
        return None

    scored: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
    for subtopic, keywords, weight in RULES:
        hits = sum(1 for kw in keywords if keyword_hit(blob, kw))
        if hits == 0:
            continue
        scored.append((subtopic, weight + hits * 4))
    if not scored:
        if any(k in blob for k in ("fission",)):
            return "27.1C Nuclear fission", 1
        if any(k in blob for k in ("nuclear fusion", "deuterium", "tritium", "thermonuclear")):
            return "27.1D Nuclear fusion", 1
        if any(k in blob for k in ("binding", "mass defect", "energy released")):
            return "27.1B Mass-energy relation", 1
        if any(k in blob for k in ("half-life", "half life", "activity", "decay constant")):
            return "25.4 Rates of radioactive decay half-life and activity", 1
        if any(k in blob for k in ("decay", "nuclide", "isotope", "alpha", "beta")):
            return "25.2B Radioactive decay", 1
        return "25.1 Ionizing radiation", 1
    scored.sort(key=lambda t: t[1], reverse=True)
    return scored[0]


def mc_png(record: dict) -> Path:
    year, qn = record["Year"], record["Question"]
    for base in (PROCESSED / "MC", WORKSPACE_MC):
        path = base / str(year) / f"q{qn}.png"
        if path.exists():
            return path
    return PROCESSED / "MC" / str(year) / f"q{qn}.png"


def lq_png(record: dict) -> Path:
    return PROCESSED / "LQ" / str(record["Year"]) / f"q{record['Question']}.png"


def dest_name(record: dict) -> str:
    return f"{record['Year']}_q{record['Question']}.png"


def sort_key(record: dict):
    year = record["Year"]
    year_key = (0, int(year)) if str(year).isdigit() else (1, str(year))
    return (*year_key, int(record["Question"]))


def write_pdf(paths: list[Path], dest: Path) -> None:
    if not paths:
        if dest.exists():
            dest.unlink()
        return
    doc = fitz.open()
    try:
        for path in paths:
            image = fitz.open(path)
            try:
                rect = image[0].rect
                page = doc.new_page(width=rect.width, height=rect.height)
                page.insert_image(page.rect, filename=str(path))
            finally:
                image.close()
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        doc.save(dest, garbage=4, deflate=True)
    finally:
        doc.close()


def main() -> None:
    for child in list(OUT.iterdir()):
        if child.name == "build_radiation_pack.py":
            continue
        if child.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(child)
        else:
            child.unlink()

    mc_records = json.loads(MC_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    lq_records = json.loads(LQ_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    buckets: dict[str, dict[str, list[dict]]] = {s: {"mc": [], "lq": []} for s in SUBTOPICS}
    classification: list[dict] = []

    for kind, records, png_fn in (
        ("mc", mc_records, mc_png),
        ("lq", lq_records, lq_png),
    ):
        for record in records:
            result = classify(record, kind)
            if result is None:
                continue
            subtopic, score = result
            src = png_fn(record)
            if not src.exists():
                print(f"missing {kind} png: {src}")
                continue
            buckets[subtopic][kind].append(record)
            classification.append(
                {
                    "Type": kind.upper(),
                    "Year": record["Year"],
                    "Question": record["Question"],
                    "Subtopic": subtopic,
                    "score": score,
                    "PNG": str(src),
                }
            )

    summary: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    all_mc: list[Path] = []
    all_lq: list[Path] = []
    seen_mc: set[str] = set()
    seen_lq: set[str] = set()

    for subtopic in SUBTOPICS:
        folder = OUT / subtopic
        mc_dir = folder / "mc"
        lq_dir = folder / "lq"
        mc_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        lq_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        mc_paths: list[Path] = []
        for record in sorted(buckets[subtopic]["mc"], key=sort_key):
            dest = mc_dir / dest_name(record)
            shutil.copy2(mc_png(record), dest)
            mc_paths.append(dest)
            if dest.name not in seen_mc:
                seen_mc.add(dest.name)
                all_mc.append(dest)

        lq_paths: list[Path] = []
        for record in sorted(buckets[subtopic]["lq"], key=sort_key):
            dest = lq_dir / dest_name(record)
            shutil.copy2(lq_png(record), dest)
            lq_paths.append(dest)
            if dest.name not in seen_lq:
                seen_lq.add(dest.name)
                all_lq.append(dest)

        write_pdf(mc_paths, folder / "mc.pdf")
        write_pdf(lq_paths, folder / "lq.pdf")
        write_pdf(mc_paths + lq_paths, folder / "combined.pdf")
        summary[subtopic] = {"mc": len(mc_paths), "lq": len(lq_paths)}
        print(f"{subtopic}: MC={len(mc_paths)} LQ={len(lq_paths)}")

    write_pdf(sorted(all_mc, key=lambda p: p.name), OUT / "all_mc.pdf")
    write_pdf(sorted(all_lq, key=lambda p: p.name), OUT / "all_lq.pdf")
    write_pdf(
        sorted(all_mc, key=lambda p: p.name) + sorted(all_lq, key=lambda p: p.name),
        OUT / "all.pdf",
    )

    (OUT / "classification.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(classification, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (OUT / "summary.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    lines = [
        "# Radiation tutorial pack",
        "",
        "Past-paper MC and long questions for Ch.25 / Ch.27 subtopics.",
        "",
        "Open each subtopic's `combined.pdf`, or root `all.pdf` / `all_mc.pdf` / `all_lq.pdf`.",
        "",
        "| Subtopic | MC | LQ | Review |",
        "|---|---:|---:|---|",
    ]
    for subtopic in SUBTOPICS:
        n = summary[subtopic]
        lines.append(
            f"| {subtopic} | {n['mc']} | {n['lq']} | `{subtopic}/combined.pdf` |"
        )
    lines += [
        "",
        f"**Totals:** {len(seen_mc)} MC, {len(seen_lq)} LQ.",
        "",
        "Photoelectric / pure heat / wave questions are excluded.",
        "",
    ]
    (OUT / "README.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Totals: MC={len(seen_mc)} LQ={len(seen_lq)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
